title: The Science Club Desk
question: 把今天的“不要只凭外表判断人”放进校园社团展示场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: A girl in sports clothes stood at the window of the science club room. Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in and asked to see a robot model. The helper did not like the way she was dressed. The next morning she returned in her school uniform with a project folder. Not realizing who she was, the helper was eager to help her this time. She politely reminded him that respect should not depend on clothes.
